text: The Glorious Knights shall throw themselves without hesitation into the war against the enemies of Order.
The miracle of the Grail Champion is reborn in the mortal world—here and now, a new legend is being written!
The proud lion dares to face any challenge.
As the war grows ever more bloody, these frenzied warriors shall fight even unto death.
These noble knights shall always lend an unconditional hand when the people are in need.
